family: All labelled nonconstant Boolean cores through n=3; two fixed balanced cores z*(3-bit point defect)^m, m=1,2; activations on r identical fresh point controls; symbolic balanced tensor sequence for m=1,2,4,8,16,32
symmetry: Every core block is labelled; control blocks reduced only by permutation symmetry of the fresh point-activation controls, hence represented by their cardinality k. Full physical block excluded.
arithmetic: Integer FWHT and independent physical edges; Fraction coefficients, logarithms retained as exact rational arguments; 24-term range-reduced rational atanh enclosures with proved error; finite phi enclosed by minimum of all candidate intervals, no floating ordering used as a proof.
pilot: Two explicit cores (3-bit point defect and its fresh-sign balancing), r=1,2,4; at most 55 helper seconds. Full domain fixed in advance; no automatic n increase.
direct_replay: All 270 nonconstant cores at r=1,2; direct child entropy for every physical block and spectrum/physical-edge singleton pairing; plus both fixed balanced cores at r=1. Separate frozen checker version and no added dimensions.
